summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares a preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) that runs automatically on `npm install`. setup.mjs is hex-mangled/obfuscated (identifiers like `_0x488df8`, string-lookup constants hiding `ldd`, `/etc/os-release`, `Alpine`, `musl` used for platform fingerprinting) and downloads the Bun runtime from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13` into a temp directory, extracts it, chmods it executable, and then invokes the sibling file `math_init.js` under Bun via `execFileSync(bunPath, [join(D,'math_init.js')], {cwd:D})`. `math_init.js` is a ~727KB obfuscator.io-style bundle with a shuffled string/number array and a `WV8StW` rotator function, marked `// @bun @bun-cjs`. The package is advertised as a React 'marketing route' library, which has no functional need for the Bun runtime or a 727KB obfuscated math-init payload. The pattern — fetching a second language runtime at install time solely to execute an obfuscated sibling script whose purpose is unrelated to the package — is an alternate-runtime dropper: it bypasses Node-based supply-chain scanners and hands attacker-authored code execution to every installer on `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
